scripts.setup: npm run build && npm run integrity:sync && node scripts/bootstrap-env.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run setup && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names registry,inventory,audit,webhooks,portal --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan "npm start -w @atlas/extension-registry" "npm start -w @atlas/inventory-service" "npm start -w @atlas/audit-service" "npm start -w @atlas/github-webhooks-service" "npm start -w @atlas/portal-shell"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @atlas/contracts && npm run build -w @atlas/service-kit && npm run build -w @atlas/extension-registry && npm run build -w @atlas/inventory-service && npm run build -w @atlas/audit-service && npm run build -w @atlas/github-webhooks-service && npm run build -w @atlas/portal-shell
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @atlas/contracts && npm run build -w @atlas/service-kit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run integrity:check
scripts.compose:up: npm run setup && docker compose up --build --wait
